from pathlib import Path
src = Path('input_model.py').read_text()
a, rest = src.split('@avelang.jit\ndef _linear(', 1)
a = a.replace('128x128 WGMMA; two consumers share each two-stage TMA tile.', '128x160 WGMMA; two consumers share two K128 TMA stages.')
a = a.replace('col_start = S.block_id(0) * 128', 'col_start = S.block_id(0) * 160')
a = a.replace('b_shared = S.make_shared((2, 8192)', 'b_shared = S.make_shared((2, 20480)')
a = a.replace('a_shared = S.make_shared((2, 8192)', 'a_shared = S.make_shared((2, 16384)')
a = a.replace('b_tensor, S.make_layout((128, 1, 64), (64, 8192, 1))', 'b_tensor, S.make_layout((160, 1, 64), (64, 10240, 1))')
a = a.replace('S.full((1, 64)', 'S.full((1, 80)')
a = a.replace('for kt in S.range(32):', 'for kt in S.range(16):')
a = a.replace('warpgroup * 4096', 'warpgroup * 8192')
a = a.replace('(stage, 0), (1, 8192)', '(stage, 0), (1, 10240)')
a = a.replace('S.make_layout((128, 64), (64, 1))', 'S.make_layout((160, 64), (64, 1))')
a = a.replace('wgmma_m64n128k16', 'wgmma_m64n160k16')
a = a.replace('            S.nvvm.wgmma_group_sync_aligned()', '''            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n160k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da + 512, db + 1280, acc, 1)
            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n160k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da + 514, db + 1282, acc, 1)
            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n160k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da + 516, db + 1284, acc, 1)
            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n160k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da + 518, db + 1286, acc, 1)
            S.nvvm.wgmma_group_sync_aligned()''')
a = a.replace('for i in S.range(64, unroll=True):', 'for i in S.range(80, unroll=True):')
a = a.replace('for group in S.range(16, unroll=True):', 'for group in S.range(20, unroll=True):')
start = a.index('            S.nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(full,')
end = a.index('            if stage == 1:', start)
a = a[:start] + '''            S.nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(full, 73728, stage, elected)
            for part in S.range(2, unroll=True):
                a_dst = S.view(
                    S.subview(a_shared, (stage, part * 8192), (1, 8192), (1, 1)),
                    S.bf16, S.make_layout((128, 1, 64), (64, 8192, 1)),
                )
                b_dst = S.view(
                    S.subview(b_shared, (stage, part * 10240), (1, 10240), (1, 1)),
                    S.bf16, S.make_layout((160, 1, 64), (64, 10240, 1)),
                )
                S.nvvm.tma_load(
                    a_dst, a_map, (0, kt * 2 + part, row_start), full,
                    mbar_id=stage, predicate=elected, expect_tx=False,
                )
                S.nvvm.tma_load(
                    b_dst, b_map, (0, kt * 2 + part, col_start), full,
                    mbar_id=stage, predicate=elected, expect_tx=False,
                )
''' + a[end:]
# Each K64 half contains all 128 A rows. The row-group offset is 4096;
# the second K half is 8192 elements after the first.
a = a.replace('(stage, warpgroup * 8192)', '(stage, warpgroup * 4096)')
a = a.replace('da + 512', 'da + 1024').replace('da + 514', 'da + 1026').replace('da + 516', 'da + 1028').replace('da + 518', 'da + 1030')
src = a + '@avelang.jit\ndef _linear(' + rest
src = src.replace('((40, 4, 1), (288, 1, 1))', '((32, 4, 1), (288, 1, 1))')
Path('output_model_new.py').write_text(src)
PY",max_output_tokens:2000}));
